script.title: NEW INTERNET DAY
script.story_hook: A two-hour window, a blinking box, one dead bedroom.
script.intro_zh: 兩小時的服務時段、一個閃燈數據機，還有樓上收訊死角。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to install day at a new apartment. Listen for tech and setup words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到新公寓的裝機日。留意科技和設定的說法。
script.outro: Full bars, box recycled, and signed for. Listen twice and repeat each line.
script.outro_zh: 滿格訊號、資源回收、簽名完成。聽兩遍再逐句跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat this whole install, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來逐句跟讀這整段裝機對話。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early twenties with a shaggy brown mop under a gray beanie, a denim jacket over a black band tee, white earbuds around his neck, a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a woman in her mid thirties with a short curly copper bob tucked under a company cap, a khaki utility vest with tool loops over a blue work shirt, sturdy boots, an athletic build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, you must be the internet person.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ju məst bi ði ˈɪntɚnɛt ˈpɝsən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你一定是來裝網路的技師吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me, sorry we're twenty minutes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi ˈsɑɹi wɪɹ ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是我，抱歉，我們遲到二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it's fine, I just finished lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪts faɪn aɪ dʒʌst fɪnɪʃt lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，沒關係，我剛好才吃完午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two-hour window lied to us both, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tuː ˈaʊɚ ˈwɪndoʊ laɪd tə ʌs boʊθ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 那個兩小時時段根本是騙我們倆的，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worries really. Where do we start?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz ˈɹɪli wɛɹ du wi stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 真的別放在心上。從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, the white box from your welcome kit.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst ðə waɪt bɑks fɹʌm jɔɹ ˈwɛlkəm kɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先是歡迎套件裡那台白色小機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This little one? What's it called again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlɪɾəl wʌn wʌts ɪt kɔld əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 這個小小的？它叫什麼來著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the modem, the gatekeeper of your wifi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə ˈmoʊdɛm ðə ˈɡeɪtˌkipɚ əv jɔɹ ˈwaɪfaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是數據機，你家 wifi 的守門員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gatekeeper, cute. Where does it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡeɪtˌkipɚ kjut wɛɹ dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 守門員，好可愛。它要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where's the cable jack in this place?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹz ðə ˈkeɪbəl dʒæk ɪn ðɪs pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這屋裡的有線電視插孔在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, behind the shelf? The loose one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ʃɛlf ðə lus wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，書架後面那個嗎？鬆鬆的那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that wall. Let's hook it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt wɔl lɛts hʊk ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 對，那面牆。我們來接線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click, click... hooked up. Now what?
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk klɪk hʊkt ʌp naʊ wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 喀、喀……接好了。接下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I call dispatch to activate your line.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ kɔl dɪˈspætʃ tə ˈæktɪˌveɪt jɔɹ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 現在我打給調度中心，啟動你的線路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that take long?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt teɪk lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那要花很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes, it's already ringing.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts ɪts ɔlˈrɛdi ˈɹɪŋɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘，已經在響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask about the plan while we wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /kənaɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə plæn ˌwaɪl wi ˈweɪt/
dialogue.zh: 趁等待的空檔，我能問一下方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, you're on the gig plan, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ jʊɹ ɑn ðə ɡɪɡ plæn ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你選的是千兆方案，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think that's the one I clicked.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæts ði wʌn aɪ klɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 我記得我就是點了那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gig means super fast, streaming heaven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪɡ minz ˈsuːpɚ fæst ˈstrimin ˈhɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 千兆代表超快，串流天堂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My roommate will love that, he games all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɹuːmmeɪt wɪl lʌv ðæt hi ɡeɪmz ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我室友會愛死，他都打一整天遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you'll want one more thing later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊl wɑnt wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ˈleɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那你等等會想再添一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The activation's done already? That was quick!
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌæktɪˈveɪʃənz dʌn ɔlˈrɛdi ðæt wʌz kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 啟動已經好了？好快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky timing, the light is blinking green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ˈtaɪmɪŋ ðə laɪt ɪz ˈblɪŋkɪŋ ɡɹin/
dialogue.zh: 運氣正好，燈正在閃綠光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blinking green means working, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblɪŋkɪŋ ɡɹin minz ˈwɝkɪŋ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 閃綠光就是能用了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Now let's test the speed downstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt naʊ lɛts tɛst ðə spid daʊnˈstɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 對。我們先在樓下測測網速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that page loaded instantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæt peɪdʒ ˈloʊdɪd ˈɪnstəntli/
dialogue.zh: 哇，網頁一下就開好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers look great, ninety-eight percent of gig.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚz lʊk ɡɹeɪt ˈnaɪnti eɪt pɚˈsɛnt əv ɡɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 數字很漂亮，有千兆的百分之九十八。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, we're all done? Should I tip?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɪɹ ɔl dʌn ʃʊd aɪ tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 所以都搞定了？我要給小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tip needed, but there's one more check.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tɪp ˈnidɪd bʌt ðɛɹz wʌn mɔɹ tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 不用小費，不過還有一項檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The upstairs bedroom, I figured.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈʌpˈstɛɹz ˈbɛdɹʊm aɪ ˈfɪɡjɚd/
dialogue.zh: 是樓上臥室對吧，我就知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, you're right, signal drops up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jʊɹ ɹaɪt ˈsɪɡnəl drops ʌp ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你猜對了，樓上訊號會掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My videos always freeze at night up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈvidioʊz ˈɔlweɪz friz æt naɪt ʌp ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我晚上在樓上看影片都會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll show you two fixes: extender or mesh.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ʃoʊ ju tuː fɪks ɪkˈstɛndɚ ɔɹ mɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 有兩種解法：訊號延伸器或網狀系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In short, what's the difference?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ʃɔɹt wʌts ðə ˈdɪfɚəns/
dialogue.zh: 簡單說，兩者差在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An extender borrows the signal, mesh shares it.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ɪkˈstɛndɚ ˈbɑɹoʊz ðə ˈsɪɡnəl mɛʃ ʃɛɹz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 延伸器是借訊號，網狀系統是分散訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mesh sounds fancier, and pricier?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɛʃ saʊndz ˈfænsiɚ ænd ˈpraɪsiɚ/
dialogue.zh: 網狀的聽起來更高級，也更貴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The extender is twenty, mesh runs fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɪkˈstɛndɚ ɪz ˈtwɛnti mɛʃ ɹʌnz ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 延伸器二十塊，網狀系統要五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty is nothing if my shows stop buffering.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪf maɪ ʃoʊz stɑp ˈbɝfɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只要我的劇不再轉圈圈，二十塊不算什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try free first: I'll move the router to the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ fɹi fɝst aɪl muv ðə ˈɹaʊtɚ tə ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 先試免費的：我把分享器搬到走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway closet? That's in the middle, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ ˈklɑzɪt ðæts ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 走廊的儲藏室？位置就在正中間，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closets are actually great for signals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɑzɪts ɑɹ ˈæktʃuəli ɡɹeɪt fɚ ˈsɪɡnəlz/
dialogue.zh: 其實儲藏室對訊號最有利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh, learn something new every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ lɝn ˈsʌmθɪŋ nuː ˈɛvɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，每天都能學到新東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go test your room now, I'll wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ tɛst jɔɹ ɹʊm naʊ aɪl weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你現在上去測試，我在這等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh my, full bars! Is that legal?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ fʊl bɑɹz ɪz ðæt ˈligəl/
dialogue.zh: 我的天，滿格了！這合法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally legal, placement is half the trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli ˈligəl ˈpleɪsmənt ɪz hæf ðə tɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 完全合法，擺放位置就是訣竅的一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free fix, I appreciate that a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹiː fɪks aɪ əˈpɹiʃieɪt ðæt ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 免費的解法，我真的很感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One last thing, the password's on the sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ ðə ˈpæswɝdz ɑn ðə ˈstɪkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，密碼在貼紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Anything I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛnɪθɪŋ aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。有什麼要我簽的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tap this green box on my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tæp ðɪs ɡɹin bɑks ɑn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 在我手機上點這個綠色方塊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed, sealed, delivered.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd sil dɪˈlɪvɚd/
dialogue.zh: 簽名完成，一切到位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the receipt email, it has support hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ɹiˈsit ˈimeɪl ɪt hæz səˈpɔɹt ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 收據郵件留好，裡面有客服時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Can you take the empty box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl duː kæn ju teɪk ði ˈɛmpi bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 我會留著。你可以順手帶走空紙箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, recycling is part of my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ˌɹiˈsaɪklɪŋ ɪz pɑɹt əv maɪ dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 當然，回收也是我工作的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɔt əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你今天什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty years of installs teaches a few things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti jɪɹz əv ɪnˈstɔlz ˈtitʃəz ə fu θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 裝了二十年機，總會學到幾招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, nailed it, tech legend.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ neɪld ɪt tɛk ˈlɛdʒənd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，完美收工，傳說級技師！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, enjoy the fast internet!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə fæst ˈɪntɚnɛt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，好好享受快速網路！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sure will. Have a great afternoon!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊɹ wɪl hæv ə ɡɹeɪt ˌæftɚˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 一定會的。祝你下午愉快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, and text if anything blinks red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tuː ænd tɛkst ɪf ˈɛnɪθɪŋ blɪŋks ɹɛd/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，只要有紅燈閃爍就傳訊給我。

script.youtube_title: 【安裝網路📶】「密碼在貼紙上」一場兩小時時段裡的滿格救援🧰✨🎧｜聽完就會搞定收訊死角｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Scheduling an Internet Install
script.youtube_title_en: "The Password's On The Sticker" — Internet Install Day and the Dead Bedroom
script.youtube_description:
「那個兩小時時段，根本是騙我們倆的。」新公寓裝網路當天，遲到二十分鐘的技師到了，樓上的收訊卻還是大問題。這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，從接上數據機一路聽到滿格訊號。

你會聽到：怎麼問價位與方案（You're on the gig plan, right?）；啟動線路、看指示燈、測速的整套流程語；延伸器和網狀系統差在哪（An extender borrows the signal, mesh shares it.）；還有免費調整擺位、簽名、拿密碼貼紙的全部句子。

整段都是 A2 初級短句，都是美式自然語感：ha, huh, oh my, totally legal。聽完你就會用：Where do we start?、In short, what's the difference?、Anything I sign?、Have a great afternoon。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，下次裝機日換你冷靜指揮全場。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The two-hour window lied to us both." Install day at a new apartment: the tech is twenty minutes late, and the upstairs bedroom still has no signal. This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice that follows a full internet installation from the modem box to full bars.

You will hear: asking about plans and prices (You're on the gig plan, right?); the activation, blinking lights, and speed-test routine; the extender-versus-mesh conversation (An extender borrows the signal, mesh shares it.); plus a free fix by moving the router, signing on a phone, and finding the password sticker.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences with natural American fillers like ha, huh, oh my, totally legal. By the end you'll own phrases like Where do we start?, In short, what's the difference?, and Anything I sign?

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and run your own install day like a pro.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧裝機日英文｜啟動線路・網狀系統・收訊死角｜密碼就在貼紙上！｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
搬進新公寓第一天就是裝機日，等了兩小時時段，技師還遲到二十分鐘，這一天該怎麼收場？

這一集帶大家走進新公寓的裝機日，從接上數據機、打電話啟動線路，到樓上臥室收訊卡關、延伸器和網狀系統怎麼選，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧰 見面第一句：Hi, you must be the internet person.
📡 學新知識：An extender borrows the signal, mesh shares it.
😲 免費妙解：Oh my, full bars! Is that legal?
🔐 收尾細節：One last thing, the password's on the sticker.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 huh、oh my、totally 這種真實語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這次裝機走一趟，下次網路再卡，你也能從容問到重點。

祝你的每一格訊號，永遠綠燈。

script.thumbnail_action: holding up a phone with a full wifi icon beside a blinking green modem
